name: Medina County, OH
findings: Medina County has 554 nonprofit organizations. 248 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 183 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Medina County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Foundation organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 29 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 29 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do foundation organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few research and think tank organizations list membership
observations.text: 1 research and think tank organization here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 5 would.

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.
